categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: True SSG - full content visible without JS execution
HTTPS/HSTS fully enforced
Clean kebab-case French URLs
Working 308 redirects for legacy alias routes
Real 404s, valid sitemap/robots.txt structure

findings.title: Duplicate title/meta tags on every page
findings.description: index.html hardcodes a generic title/description that survives alongside each page's correct per-page Head output on all 18 routes.
findings.recommendation: Remove the hardcoded tags from index.html; rely exclusively on per-page Head components.

findings.title: No canonical tags anywhere
findings.description: Zero link rel=canonical found on any of 9+ sampled pages, ahead of a pending domain migration and with legacy alias routes live.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical tags now; flip domain at keprea.com cutover.

findings.title: Hero video eagerly preloaded
findings.description: 13MB hero video uses preload="auto", competing with critical CSS/JS/fonts for bandwidth on load.
findings.recommendation: Switch to preload="metadata" or lazy-trigger playback; re-encode to 2-3MB.

findings.title: /innovation missing from sitemap
findings.description: Live, nav-linked page not included in sitemap.xml's 13 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add https://keprea.vercel.app/innovation to sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Legacy duplicate routes depend entirely on redirect config
findings.description: App.tsx still registers 4 legacy routes as live React Router routes, masked only by vercel.json 308 redirects with no canonical-tag backstop.
findings.recommendation: Remove redundant Route entries from App.tsx once canonical tags ship.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present; CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all absent.
findings.recommendation: Add a headers block to vercel.json.

findings.title: Static OG/Twitter tags with no og:url
findings.description: Identical social card metadata across all 18 pages; no og:url at all.
findings.recommendation: Move OG/Twitter tags into each page's Head block.

findings.title: Legal pages have no page-specific Head override
findings.description: /mentions-legales relies entirely on the duplicate generic tags with no unique title.
findings.recommendation: Add unique Head blocks to legal pages.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Transparent, non-fabricated handling of the missing-testimonials gap on the homepage
SIRET/address/email visible in footer
Strong FAQ/step-by-step structure on product pages (AI-citability bones)

findings.title: Live internal placeholder note on /qui-sommes-nous
findings.description: 'Photo à faire ensemble le 15 OCT' rendered as a visible overlay on the team photo, in all 5 languages, on the live production site.
findings.recommendation: Remove team.photoNote from Team.tsx and all 5 LanguageContext.tsx entries immediately.

findings.title: Named individuals with unverifiable affiliation on Team page
findings.description: 6 named people listed with only name + one-line role, no bios/credentials; some names plausibly correspond to known public figures.
findings.recommendation: Verify accuracy and consent with each individual before further exposure; build real bios or remove unverified entries.

findings.title: /ressources is functionally empty
findings.description: ~169 words, all content cards marked 'coming soon'.
findings.recommendation: Publish real content or noindex the page until ready.

findings.title: /qui-sommes-nous and /notre-production well under word-count floor
findings.description: 282 and 232 words respectively vs. a ~500-600 word floor for this page type.
findings.recommendation: Expand with concrete milestones, certifications, production figures.

findings.title: Product pages 30-45% under thin-content floor
findings.description: 523-589 words vs. an 800-word service-page floor; confirms the open ERRORS.md thin-content item with hard numbers.
findings.recommendation: Deepen existing FAQ/spec/compatibility sections rather than add new ones.

findings.title: Repetitive boilerplate across product pages
findings.description: Near-verbatim CTA and cross-sell copy repeated across all 4 product pages.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite connective/CTA sentences per page.

findings.title: Unattributed statistics mixed with cited sources
findings.description: 'Données internes' appears in the same source line as legitimate third-party citations (ITAB, IBMA), diluting credibility of both.
findings.recommendation: Separate internal claims from third-party citations; add methodology notes.

findings.title: No author/byline or last-updated date
findings.description: Pages making regulatory claims (Plan Ecophyto 2+, EU 2018/848) have no authorship or freshness signal.
findings.recommendation: Add a byline block to regulatory/technical content pages.

No deprecated schema types found

findings.title: Organization schema domain mismatch
findings.description: url/logo point to keprea.com while the live site is keprea.vercel.app, with no canonical tag to reconcile it.
findings.recommendation: Confirm canonical domain and align url/logo/OG images/canonical tags consistently.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList anywhere
findings.description: Clean URL hierarchy exists but has no breadcrumb markup on any inner page.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList to all inner pages.

findings.title: No WebSite schema or sameAs enrichment
findings.description: Homepage lacks WebSite schema; Organization has no sameAs social links.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite schema and sameAs once verified profiles exist.

findings.title: No product-level schema on solution pages
findings.description: 4 solution pages have no Product/Service schema despite named products with composition data.
findings.recommendation: Add Service schema (preferred) or factual-only Product schema with no offers/ratings.

categories.name: Sitemap
what_works: Valid XML, all 13 URLs return 200 and match real routes
Legacy alias URLs correctly excluded, verified redirecting via 308

findings.title: /innovation missing from sitemap
findings.description: Live, nav-linked page not covered.
findings.recommendation: Add to sitemap.xml.

findings.title: robots.txt sitemap directive points to a domain not yet live
findings.description: Sitemap: https://keprea.com/sitemap.xml currently 404s; already a tracked pre-migration item.
findings.recommendation: Resolve at keprea.com cutover.

findings.title: priority/changefreq ignored by Google

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Excellent TTFB (~50ms), edge-cached static SSG HTML
CLS risk low - pre-sized containers throughout

findings.title: 13MB hero video eagerly preloaded
findings.description: preload="auto" on a 13MB single-format MP4 competes with critical CSS/JS/fonts on initial load.
findings.recommendation: Switch to preload="metadata"; re-encode to 2-3MB.

findings.title: 2.49MB uncompressed PNG
findings.description: Production-section image served as PNG at full resolution despite rendering in a small fixed container.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF, compress to match rendered size.

findings.title: Monolithic 722KB JS bundle
findings.description: No visible route-based code-splitting; same bundle loads on every page.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate React.lazy/dynamic import for page-specific sections.

findings.title: No CrUX/PSI field data obtained
findings.description: PSI API was rate-limited this session; all performance figures are lab estimates.
findings.recommendation: Re-run with GOOGLE_API_KEY configured for authoritative field data.

categories.name: Visual / Mobile
what_works: No horizontal scroll or console errors across 6 page/viewport combinations
Single H1 confirmed on all pages, strong CTA contrast, no decorative emoji

findings.title: Contact form not visible above the fold on mobile
findings.description: At 375px, zero actionable element (no field, no submit CTA) is visible on the highest-intent page.
findings.recommendation: Tighten vertical spacing above the form on mobile.

findings.title: Cookie banner obscures content on mobile load
findings.description: Expected RGPD behavior but reduces effective above-fold area further.
findings.recommendation: No change required to consent behavior; consider compact banner variant on mobile.

findings.title: Touch targets under 48px
findings.description: Cookie banner, hamburger, and language switcher controls measure 36-46px.
findings.recommendation: Increase to ~44-48px on mobile.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Fully server-rendered content, no JS-dependent SPA gap for AI crawlers
All major AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot) verified allowed
Well-formed FAQ Q&A sections on 4 product pages in ideal citation format

findings.title: No FAQPage schema despite qualifying content
findings.description: 4 product pages have genuine FAQ sections with no markup - highest-leverage single fix for AI/LLM citation.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema (for AI citation value only, not Google SERP rich results, which were retired May 2026).

findings.title: llms.txt missing
findings.description: No llms.txt found at the root.
findings.recommendation: Add at keprea.com launch, summarizing product lines and key URLs.

findings.title: robots.txt sitemap directive 404s
findings.description: Points to keprea.com/sitemap.xml which isn't live yet.
findings.recommendation: Fix at domain cutover.

findings.title: Statistics lack source attribution
findings.description: Quotable stats (84% of crops, 5500 species, 400M years) have no linked academic/institutional source.
findings.recommendation: Add source citations to increase LLM citation trust.
